rows.grounds: subtle bodily channels mentioned in prior verses
refers back to the previously described channels
mental act of conceiving or visualizing
compound of āvṛta and nāḍikā describing channels as enveloped

items.question: What further covering must be conceived for those channels in a subsequent stage?
premises: The channels previously described remain the subject of consideration.
A mental act of conception is applied to these channels.
This conception occurs at a subsequent stage.
items.inference: Those same channels are to be conceived afterwards as covered channels.
uncertainties: The exact nature or material of the covering is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Those channels are also to be conceived afterwards as covered channels.
